title: Distinct cellular phenotypes of language and executive decline in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: GEO series records for SuperSeries GSE315586 and SubSeries GSE290359 (single-nucleus RNA/ATAC multiome, 96 GSMs, 48 samples from 24 BA44/45 + 24 BA46), GSE313918 (Visium spatial, 246 libraries from 64 samples) and GSE314526 (bulk RNA-seq, 72 GSMs). Parsed GSE314526 sample metadata: 36 BA44 + 36 BA46 samples, phenotype column 'als phenotype' = ALS 28 / ALSci 23 / Control 21, plus sex, age, PMI (post-mortem interval). Processed h5ad/tsv files exist and return HTTP 200 on HEAD; sizes not reported, files not downloaded. Zenodo DOIs are code (cSplotch, sc_self_supervised), not data.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only (Europe PMC full text returned HTTP 500; Cell paper not open access). Cognitive stratification by a standardized screening exam is from the GEO summary; exact exam and per-subtype (language vs executive) labels not seen.

a1_downloadable.note: Processed h5ad and TSV files on GEO FTP respond HTTP 200; open, no login. Checked headers only.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Donor phenotype (Control / ALS / ALSci = ALS with cognitive impairment) is a GEO sample characteristic, seen in GSE314526 metadata. Language-vs-executive subtype not seen as a column.

a3_inputs_present.note: Expression matrices (counts, TPM, h5ad) are deposited per GEO file listing; not opened.

a4_units_stated.note: Counts and TPM (transcripts per million) named in file names; categorical label needs no units.

a5_enough_rows.note: The unit for predicting cognitive status is the donor: bulk set has 72 samples = about 36 donors x 2 regions (21/28/23 samples per class); snRNA set has 24 donors. Millions of cells or spots don't change that, far below 400.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; bulk TPM table likely small
a6_fits_laptop.note: File sizes not returned by HEAD; bulk tables would fit, single-cell/spatial h5ad likely several GB.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: GEO designs are internally consistent (48 multiome, 64 spatial, 68 stated vs 72 GSMs bulk — small mismatch not resolved); paper full text unavailable to cross-check.

a8_label_provenance.note: Label comes from a clinical cognitive screening exam per GEO summary, not a model and not computed from expression.

backbone.name: scGPT or Geneformer (single-cell foundation models) would apply to the snRNA data
backbone.hardware: CPU for embeddings of a subset

honest_claim_h3: With about 36 donors, any classifier of cognitive status would claim only that expression separates Control/ALS/ALSci in this one cohort, with very wide uncertainty.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use brain-tissue gene expression from ALS patients to predict whether the patient had cognitive impairment.
plain_idea.train_on: Bulk or single-nucleus gene expression from prefrontal cortex of about 36 donors (72 bulk samples over two brain regions).
plain_idea.predict: Donor group: control, ALS without cognitive impairment, or ALS with cognitive impairment, from a standardized clinical screening exam during life.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would point to molecular correlates of cognitive decline in ALS, but with this few donors it mostly restates the paper's differential-expression findings.

ml_idea: Donor-level classification of cognitive status from brain expression; not viable at ~36 donors.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; rejected on donor count.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count distinct donors per phenotype in GEO metadata: ~36 donors in bulk, 24 in multiome — done, kills it.

verdict_reason: A5 fails: the prediction unit is the donor and there are only about 36 (bulk) or 24 (single-nucleus) donors, split three ways; cell and spot counts are pseudo-replicates. Data are open and well labelled, but too few independent patients for ML.
